HIV.D.DE17.label: Signs of serious illness
HIV.D.DE17.description: Signs that may indicate the client has a serious illness and needs triage or an emergency referral

options.label: Fever of 39 C or greater
options.description: Client has a fever with a measured temperature of 102.2 F/39 C or greater

options.label: Tachycardia
options.description: Heart rate above a rate per minute based on age

options.label: Tachypnea
options.description: Respiratory rate above a number of breaths per minute based on age

options.label: Unable to walk unaided
options.description: Client is not able to walk without help

options.label: Lethargy
options.description: Client is exhibiting lethargy as a sign of serious illness

options.label: Unconsciousness
options.description: Client is currently unconscious

options.label: Convulsions
options.description: Client is convulsing

options.label: Unable to drink
options.description: Child is not able to drink

options.label: Unable to breastfeed
options.description: Infant or child is not able to breastfeed

options.label: Repeated vomiting
options.description: Client is repeatedly vomiting

options.label: Headache
options.description: Client is exhibiting a headache

options.label: Other sign of serious illness
options.description: Client is exhibiting another sign of a serious illness

options.label: Clinical failure
options.description: New or recurrent clinical event indicating severe immunodeficiency in adults or advanced or severe immunodeficiency in children

options.label: Immunological failure
options.description: CD4 count at or below 250 cells/mm3 following clinical failure

options.label: Virological failure
options.description: The inability to achieve or maintain viral suppression below a certain threshold indicated by viral load above 1000 copies/mL based on two consecutive viral load measurements in 3 months, with adherence support following the first viral load test

HIV.D.DE391.label: Reason for HIV viral load test
HIV.D.DE391.description: Whether the viral load is being tested for routine monitoring on a set schedule or for targeted monitoring for suspected treatment failure

options.label: Routine viral load test
options.description: Routine refers to viral load tests obtained at standard intervals following ART initiation to monitor viral load response to ART

options.label: Targeted viral load monitoring
options.description: Targeted refers to viral load tests obtained based on a specific clinical indication (such as concern about disease progression or failure to respond to ART)

options.label: Initial viral load test
options.description: The first viral load test of the client

options.label: Follow-up viral load test after receiving enhanced adherence counselling
options.description: A follow-up viral load test within 3-6 months after enhanced adherence counselling after client received a high viral load test result

HIV.D.DE466.label: Type of treatment-limiting toxicity
HIV.D.DE466.description: Type of treatment-limiting toxicity experienced by client. Treatment-limiting toxicity is defined as a serious adverse drug reaction that results in drug discontinuation or substitution. In addition, any reaction that leads to treatment interruption or requires changing the drug or regimen because of an adverse drug reaction is also considered a serious adverse drug reaction.

options.label: Gastrointestinal
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to GI issues (nausea, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, vomiting)

options.label: Skin issues
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to skin issues (rash, hypersensitivity reaction)

options.label: Peripheral neuropathy
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to peripheral neuropathy (burning/numbness/ tingling)

options.label: Central nervous system symptoms
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to central nervous system symptoms (dizzy, anxiety, nightmare, depression, seizures)

options.label: Weight gain
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to weight gain

options.label: Hepatic dysfunction
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to hepatic dysfunction (jaundice)

options.label: Haematological disorders
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to haematological (anaemia, neutropenia) disorders

options.label: Fatigue
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to fatigue

options.label: Headache
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to headache

options.label: Bone dysfunction
options.description: Treatment-limiting toxicity due to bone dysfunction (fractures, osteopenia)
